fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects when 'DllRegisterServer' is called in the commandline and the image is not rundll32. This could mean that the 'rundll32' utility has been renamed in order to avoid detection
fields.name: Potential Renamed Rundll32 Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "DllRegisterServer" and (not tgt.process.image.path contains "\\rundll32.exe")))
